market_positions.segment_name: IaaS and PaaS for individuals and companies with <500 employees
market_positions.source: IDC: Worldwide Software and Public Cloud Services Spending Guide (Feb. 2025)
market_positions.source_note: IDC estimates the aggregate worldwide IaaS and PaaS markets for individuals and companies with less than 500 employees at approximately $138B in 2025, growing to $251B in 2028, representing a 22% CAGR. IDC defines IaaS as compute, storage and networking, and PaaS as database management systems, application platforms, AI platforms and other platform services.
